message.jaymoskingdoms.hollow_blight.too: The wound feels cold. Colder than it should. Something of the dead got in.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hollow_blight.sta: You're hungry all the time now, and nothing you eat fills you. The cold has spread.
Your hands are grey. Your heart is slow. Whatever is in you is nearly done with you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hollow_blight.cur: The gold burns going down. The cold in you burns with it, and is gone.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.124: A blow from the dead can leave a cold in you that spreads. Drink weakness, then eat a golden apple before it finishes. Until then, the zombies will leave you be, and talk to you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hollow_blight.kin: Come with us. There's no hunger where we go. Only the one.
Your heart's slowing. Listen to it.
They'll stop looking at you soon. Then you're ours.
We heard you coming. We always hear our own.
Cold, isn't it? It gets better. It gets quiet.
